race.description: Carbine Club Of Wa Race Day 3yo Plate
race.comment: MARCOS (3) won impressively first-up before missing by 0.4L last start at Northam when a $1.65 fave. Third-up now and back to 1200m, but it's the time between runs that mat gold the key. Can blend into the race at the right time and he can get back to winning ways. PROPERATA (2) won fresh before a 0.2L as the race fave in this company last time out. Out to 1200m now looks ideal for him and Faithfull remains on board. Should sit off the speed and make his presence felt. MANHATTAN SQUEEZE (9) is building nicely, dropping back to 1000m last start and missing by 0.2L in a good effort. Maps to get every chance once again from an inside barrier and she's sure to be in the finish once again. GAINTREE (10) has shown good speed at the trials coming in and Pike hops on board for the return effort. Expecting a bold effort on resumption. SPINARELLA (1) can repeat the dose without surprising.
